instruction: Every time I open Chrome on my computer, it's using Yahoo as the default search engine. I want to change this to Google instead. Can you help me fix this?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '.default_search_provider_data = {"template_url": "https://search.yahoo.com/search?p={searchTerms}"}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to change the default search engine from Yahoo to any other search engine (e.g., Google). The evaluator checks that the template_url in Chrome preferences no longer contains 'yahoo'. Verified by reading Chrome Preferences file structure.
